Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy

Class ShopTransactionContext

java.lang.Object
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy.ShopTransactionContext
public final class ShopTransactionContext extends Object
Shared context for every lifecycle event belonging to one shop transaction attempt.

The transaction id is unique per attempt. The shop id is QuickShop's persistent database id; callers must not use Shop.getRuntimeRandomUniqueId() for persistent integrations.

      public ShopTransactionContext(@NotNull @NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull @NotNull QUser trader, @NotNull @NotNull InventoryWrapper traderInventory, @NotNull @NotNull ShopTransactionDirection direction, int tradeCount, @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal unitPrice, @NotNull @NotNull BigDecimal totalPrice)
      Creates a transaction context with a generated transaction id.
      Parameters:
      shop - the shop being traded with
      trader - the player or user performing the trade
      traderInventory - the inventory participating in the trade
      direction - the direction from the trader's point of view
      tradeCount - the number of configured shop units being traded
      unitPrice - the price of one configured shop unit
      totalPrice - the effective total price before tax
